info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_ATM Network Operations Management API
info.description: The ATM Network Operations Management API facilitates operational actions related to ATM networks. This API provides capabilities such as configuring, monitoring, and managing various aspects of ATM operations to ensure optimal functionality and service delivery. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers seeking to enhance ATM network efficiency and performance. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline operational workflows and improve customer service through effective ATM management.

post.summary: Create operational actions for ATM network operations.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create specific operational actions related to ATM network operations within a designated channel. It facilitates the management and optimization of ATM functionalities, ensuring seamless network performance.
